subject: Draft MAP canvas + compact close timetable (Buildwise)
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erica Barnes <erica@buildwise.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@buildwise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP canvas + compact close timetable (Buildwise)

Hi Erica / Liam —

Thanks for the conversation earlier. Per our call, I've put together a lightweight MAP canvas and a compact close timetable to make it simple for your team to see the path to pilot and procurement. The goal here is to capture the decision owners, key milestones (tech validation, security review, PO/SOW), and the minimal evaluation criteria for a 30-day pilot.

What I'm sharing:
- MAP_canvas_v0.gdoc (link below) — single-page canvas with owners and milestone dates
- CloseTimeline_two_slide.pptx — a two-slide view for your execs that maps procurement windows to expected Redwood delivery

Suggested next step: quick working session to align owners and lock the dates. I can run a 30–40 minute workshop to populate the canvas. Proposed slots: Tue Apr 10 10:00–10:40 PT or Wed Apr 11 11:00–11:40 PT. Please pick one or suggest another time.

I've also added Marissa (CS) and Jordan (Solutions) to loop in technical & onboarding owners. If we get Legal/Procurement's earliest target dates, we can place realistic gating windows into the MAP.

Links and attachments:
- MAP doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MAPCanvasStub
- Deck: CloseTimeline_two_slide.pptx (attached)

Look forward to aligning —

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
(connor@redwoodinference.com)

(attachment: CloseTimeline_two_slide.pptx)

From: Erica Barnes <erica@buildwise.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@buildwise.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-04T12:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP canvas + compact close timetable (Buildwise)

Thanks, Connor — this is useful. We like the one-page approach. Wed Apr 11 11:00–11:40 PT works better for our team (Liam and I). A couple of notes before the session:

1) Procurement window: our procurement lead wants a 3-week review starting Apr 18, and we typically need final terms and any SOW by the start of that window.
2) Security review: our SEC/IR team needs an audit checklist (SOC2 scope + data residency note) — can you include a short security annex in the MAP?
3) Legal: please loop in whoever handles the contract template; if you can add a quick row in the canvas called 'Contract owner / template' that'd help.

We can meet Wed — please send an updated MAP doc with those rows and I'll invite our procurement manager (Maggie) if that makes sense.

Erica Barnes
Director of AI Integrations | Buildwise
erica@buildwise.com

- Maggie or procurement rep: add any preferred contract templates or required SLAs into the doc ahead of time

I've put a short action table at the top of the MAP doc; copying it here so owners can see immediate asks:
- Action: Add Procurement owner / due: 2028-04-07 / owner: Erica
- Action: Share contract template (if available) / due: 2028-04-10 / owner: Liam
- Action: Security evidence list (SOC2 scope, data flow diagram) / due: 2028-04-10 / owner: Jordan

Workshop invite to follow from my calendar for Apr 11 11:00–11:40 PT. If Procurement needs a separate sync before Apr 11, flag it and we'll add a focused slot.

Thanks — see you on Wednesday.

Connor
